These are authored test fixtures, never real broadcast schedules. The server
EPG contract fixture is generated by `website/tests/epg_contract_fixture.py`
through the current Python ingestion and atomic publisher code in a disposable
database. Source reads and both public-node checks are simulated locally. No
network request, production permission, mapping or publication is created.

The Dart contract tests import these exact compressed bytes through the normal
receiver and background-isolate decoder. The Python regression detects semantic
serializer drift while allowing gzip headers to differ across runtimes.
Passing this fixture test does not satisfy real two-version publication or
Windows/macOS/Android physical-device acceptance.
